scenes.headline: How a linear map lets a bigger model skip prefill
scenes.sub: Cross-model KV cache transfer: per-head ridge regression, no backprop.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Yarrow! Swap a small model for a bigger one, and the big one re-reads everything. Here's how to skip that.

scenes.text: Map the small model's KV cache into the big model's with a per-head linear regression, and the big model never runs its own prefill.
scenes.say: The idea: map the small model's KV cache into the big model's, one linear regression per head, and skip the big model's prefill.

steps.say: A small model has already read the conversation. Its prefill left keys and values in a KV cache.

steps.note: normally: re-prefill the whole context at the big model's price
steps.say: Swap to a bigger model, and normally it re-reads the whole context from scratch, at its own price.
Instead, a mapper turns the small cache into the big one, head by head. Both must share KV head count and size.

steps.note: 2.7 to 25x faster than re-prefill, in all 70 measured cells
steps.say: The big model decodes straight from the mapped cache, and is faster in every setting measured.

items.say: For each target head, keep the source layers that predict it best.
Strip the rotary position encoding, so the map learns content, not position.
Solve one ridge regression, in closed form. No gradient descent anywhere.
At inference, re-apply the target's own rotation, so one mapper works at any context length.

scenes.title: Key variance explained by source layers
scenes.say: Why it works: one source layer already explains over half the key variance, and eight explain most of what all forty would. The structure is largely linear.
scenes.note: Qwen3 14B to 32B, averaged across target heads

scenes.label: Model pairs tested
scenes.say: It holds on four of the six pairs tested. Two collapse, and the small network that rescues them needs real training.

scenes.text: Within a family, one model's KV cache is largely a linear map of another's: often you can map it, not recompute it.

recap: Prefill once on the small model
Map its cache per head, in closed form
Four of six pairs keep most of their accuracy
scenes.say: To recap: prefill once, map per head, and on four of six pairs, keep most of the accuracy.
